description: IATI publisher finance, organisation planning, saved refresh and native DQA customer engagements

commandDescriptions.dataset-iati: Retain complete IATI activity and organisation XML, review finance portfolios and planning documents, make precise publisher corrections, review saved refreshes, and deliver or receive the full customer history.
commandDescriptions.iati-document-evidence: Use an existing private IATI console to retain public-document evidence, review exact observations, prepare publisher URL corrections and export or receive the complete source/workspace history.
commandDescriptions.iati-document-procedure: Create and receive complete customer operating procedures from an exact saved IATI document case, with original source history, toolkit registrations and editable plan handover.
